items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:134:1
items.html: And these three discernments are made together, for through the Durmita [deep slumber] the female has no nursing by way of the male; then they separate from the posterior and are sawn, and then the Atara of Gevura and the Bina of ZA enter into her in the secret of Mochin. For in truth all these three discernments are only the matter of the raising of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] and their inclusion in the coupling of AVI, whereby through that coupling they receive the drop of the coupling from AB, which brings the bottom Hey down from the Einayim and returns the AHP, which are new NHY that complete the ten Sefirot of the Nukva, whereby she attains the GAR of the lights of BON, as above. Except that there are three discernments here. The first is the Durmita, that is, the raising of MAN. The second is the sawing, that is, the inclusion of the Nukva there in the NHY of Ima, whereby she receives from her the drop of the coupling that completes her posterior, which are the NHY of vessels, by which she is sawn off from ZA, after she attains a posterior of her own. The third is the GAR of the lights of BON that she receives there, which are the Bina and the Atara of Gevura that become Mochin for her. And these two discernments come together at the time of their rising as MAN, as explained.
